name: T3 Code
description: T3 Code is a web and desktop control surface for running coding agents on your machine.

notes.text: Provider CLIs (Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, GitHub) are included in the install. Login to the CT after creation to authenticate with these services.
Access T3 Code at http://<IP>:3773 and pair a device with the token/QR shown after install. Regenerate it with: `pct exec <CTID> -- t3 pair --base-dir /opt/t3code --ttl 1h.`
